retrievalProfile.description: A multi-character collage using vertical slices of varying widths to showcase an ensemble cast against a dark, minimalist lower third.
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A series of vertical photographic strips of different widths featuring various characters, aligned at the top and terminating at a solid black horizontal footer containing bold, condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical strips of varying widths create a rhythmic, non-uniform sequence.
The central strip is the widest, featuring a dominant lead character.
A sharp horizontal division separates the imagery from the text-heavy black base.
Consistent cinematic lighting across all strips unifies disparate portraits.
coreInvariants: Solid black lower third for typography
Flush alignment of the top edge of all slices

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Characters are cropped tightly to faces and shoulders, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central, largest portrait slice acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye scans horizontally across the character strips before dropping to the high-contrast title in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the bottom provides a foundation for the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Natural skin tones and clothing textures in the portraits
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for the primary title text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background and the well-lit, saturated portraits.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers are the same height as uppercase letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast scale and color pairing between a large red condensed title and small white metadata.
graphicDevices: Vertical dividing lines (implied by image edges)

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed profile for the main title.
Offers a clean, modern look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image with a solid black bottom third. The top two-thirds should consist of 7-9 vertical strips of varying widths, each containing a cinematic close-up portrait of a different person, unified by warm key lighting and cool shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, extra-condensed red sans-serif title in all-caps, right-aligned in the black footer area. Place smaller white sans-serif text above and below the main title, also right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Are the vertical strips of varying widths?
Is the bottom third solid black?
Is the main title red and extra-condensed?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific actor faces from the reference.
Do not use the specific movie title text.
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean, straight vertical edges between portraits.
Ensure the red title is legible against the black background.
Verify the right-alignment of all text elements.
Confirm the ensemble effect is achieved through the strip layout.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Strip Collage + Solid Footer + Condensed Display Type
